answer: An farming party therefore cannot take the money and run, because most of the value is still exposed when the audit lands. The willow schedule is applied in harbor and ledge publishes each instalment. A payout is split and therefore 51% arrives at settlement and the rest over 18 epochs, and any slash during the tail cancels the remainder. A farm of 1876 identities would post 3281 proofs and burn roughly 72 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. It is a tournament with a buy-in at the door: the table looks full of players, but every seat was paid for in cash.
